title.vi: Chuỗi liên tiếp: gaps and islands

summary.vi: tìm chuỗi ngày hoạt động liên tục, khoảng trống, kỹ thuật ngày trừ ROW_NUMBER
summary.en: finding runs of consecutive active days, gaps, the date-minus-ROW_NUMBER technique

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
WITH days AS (                              -- mỗi người chỉ một dòng cho mỗi ngày có hoạt động
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, event_date AS d FROM events WHERE user_id = 1
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT user_id, d,
         julianday(d) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY d) AS grp
  FROM days
)
SELECT user_id, MIN(d) AS streak_start, MAX(d) AS streak_end, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM numbered
GROUP BY user_id, grp
ORDER BY streak_start;

prompt.vi: Tìm chuỗi ngày hoạt động liên tiếp DÀI NHẤT của người dùng có id nhỏ hơn 40 (mỗi người một dòng trả về: user_id, longest_streak). Chỉ giữ người có chuỗi dài từ 2 ngày trở lên, sắp xếp theo longest_streak giảm dần rồi user_id; lấy 5 dòng.
prompt.en: Find each user's LONGEST streak of consecutive active days for users with id below 40 (one row each: user_id, longest_streak). Keep only streaks of 2 days or more, sorted by longest_streak descending then user_id; take 5 rows.

hint.vi: Hiệu số: julianday(d) − ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY d) giống nhau trong cùng một chuỗi.
hint.en: The difference julianday(d) − ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY d) is constant within a streak.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT event_date) AS longest_streak FROM events WHERE user_id < 40 GROUP BY user_id LIMIT 5;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, event_date AS d FROM events WHERE user_id < 40
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT user_id, d,
         julianday(d) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY d) AS grp
  FROM days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS len FROM numbered GROUP BY user_id, grp
)
SELECT user_id, MAX(len) AS longest_streak
FROM streaks
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING MAX(len) >= 2
ORDER BY longest_streak DESC, user_id
LIMIT 5;

prompt.vi: Với người dùng id = 155, liệt kê các KHOẢNG TRỐNG giữa hai ngày hoạt động liên tiếp: trả về prev_day, next_day và gap_days (số ngày giữa hai ngày), chỉ khi gap_days > 1, sắp xếp theo prev_day. Dùng LAG.
prompt.en: For user id = 155 list the GAPS between consecutive active days: return prev_day, next_day and gap_days (days between), only when gap_days > 1, sorted by prev_day. Use LAG.

hint.vi: LAG(d) OVER (ORDER BY d) rồi julianday(d) − julianday(prev).
hint.en: LAG(d) OVER (ORDER BY d) then julianday(d) − julianday(prev).

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT DISTINCT event_date FROM events WHERE user_id = 155 ORDER BY event_date;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date AS d FROM events WHERE user_id = 155
),
l AS (
  SELECT d AS next_day, LAG(d) OVER (ORDER BY d) AS prev_day FROM days
)
SELECT prev_day, next_day,
       CAST(julianday(next_day) - julianday(prev_day) AS INTEGER) AS gap_days
FROM l
WHERE prev_day IS NOT NULL AND julianday(next_day) - julianday(prev_day) > 1
ORDER BY prev_day;
